entities.name: Baankis
entities.description: A soldier of the Otarian Order under Major Teroh, killed by Chainer and the first absorbed into his dementia space.

entities.name: Otarian Order
entities.description: The military order on Dominaria that Baankis served.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Otarian Order.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A man who killed Baankis and absorbed him into his dementia space.

entities.name: Dementia space
entities.description: Chainer's realm into which Baankis was absorbed.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City outside which Baankis waited for Chainer.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact Chainer discovered and Baankis's squad tried to take.

entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: Chainer's master, killed in the pit fight.

entities.name: Fulla

events.summary: Baankis, Teroh and a Nantuko tried to take the Mirari but Chainer fled; Skellum came to take his pupil away.
events.quote: he tried to take the artifact, but Chainer managed to flee to Roup's tavern

events.summary: Baankis fought in Teroh's pit team against Skellum and Fulla; the Order team won and Skellum was killed.
events.quote: the Order team was victorious, with Braids defeated and Skellum killed

events.summary: Chainer choked the injured Baankis to death with a chain and took him into his dementia space.
events.quote: Chainer summoned one of his chains to wrap around the Sergeant's neck and slowly choked him to death.

relations.quote: who stood under the command of Major Teroh
Officer Baankis was a soldier in the Otarian Order on Dominaria
